info.title: OpenWeatherMap Current, Forecast, and Geocoding APIs
info.summary: Agent-oriented reference for selected OpenWeatherMap APIs.
info.description: Community-maintained description derived from OpenWeather documentation. Coordinate-based weather requests are preferred; use the Geocoding API to resolve place names or postal codes.

tags.name: 16-Day Forecast
tags.description: Daily forecasts for up to 16 days. Product access depends on the subscription attached to the API key.

get.description: Returns current weather for one coordinate. Omit `mode` for JSON. XML and HTML are available but are not modeled by this specification.
Returns forecast entries separated by 3 hours. `cnt` limits timestamps, not days. Omit `mode` for JSON; XML is available but not modeled.

get.summary: Get daily forecasts for up to 16 days
get.description: Returns daily forecast entries. This paid product requires an API key with an eligible subscription. Omit `mode` for JSON; XML is available but not modeled.

get.summary: Resolve a place name to coordinates
get.description: Returns matching locations. Include country and US state codes in `q` when known to reduce ambiguity.

200.description: Matching locations returned. An empty array means no match.

get.summary: Resolve a postal code to coordinates
Resolve coordinates to nearby place names

200.description: Nearby locations returned. An empty array means no match.

OpenWeatherApiKey.name: appid
OpenWeatherApiKey.description: OpenWeather API key. Configure this value in the importing client; never store a real key in this file.

Units.name: units
Units.description: Unit system. Standard uses Kelvin and meters/second; metric uses Celsius and meters/second; imperial uses Fahrenheit and miles/hour.

Language.name: lang
Language.description: OpenWeather language code used for location and weather descriptions.

CurrentWeatherMode.name: mode
CurrentWeatherMode.description: Response format. Omit for JSON. Non-JSON response schemas are not modeled.

JsonXmlMode.name: mode
JsonXmlMode.description: Response format. Omit for JSON. The XML response schema is not modeled.

ForecastCount.name: cnt
ForecastCount.description: Maximum number of 3-hour forecast timestamps to return.

DailyCount.name: cnt
DailyCount.description: Number of daily forecast entries to return.

DirectQuery.name: q
DirectQuery.description: Place query as `city`, `city,country`, or `city,state,country`. State codes apply to US locations; country codes follow ISO 3166.

ReverseLimit.name: limit
ReverseLimit.description: Maximum number of nearby location names to return.

ZipCode.name: zip
ZipCode.description: Postal code and ISO 3166 country code separated by a comma.

BadRequest.description: Required parameters are missing, malformed, or outside their allowed range.

Unauthorized.description: API key is missing, invalid, inactive, or lacks product access.

NotFound.description: No data exists for the requested parameters or the request path is invalid.

TooManyRequests.description: API-key request quota has been exceeded.

ServerError.description: OpenWeather could not process the request because of an internal or upstream service error.

StatusCode.description: OpenWeather response status value; APIs may encode it as a number or string.

main.description: Condition group such as Rain, Snow, or Clouds.

speed.description: Wind speed. Unit depends on the `units` request parameter.

gust.description: Wind gust. Unit depends on the `units` request parameter; omitted when unavailable.

1h.description: Precipitation during the previous hour in mm/h.

3h.description: Precipitation during the 3-hour period in millimeters.

temp_min.description: Optional minimum currently observed within the location; not a daily minimum.

temp_max.description: Optional maximum currently observed within the location; not a daily maximum.

sunrise.description: Sunrise as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

sunset.description: Sunset as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

dt.description: Time of data calculation as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

timezone.description: Location offset from UTC in seconds.

id.description: Internal city identifier; do not use as the primary lookup method.

temp_min.description: Optional minimum within the location at this forecast timestamp.

temp_max.description: Optional maximum within the location at this forecast timestamp.

pod.description: Day or night part for this timestamp.

dt.description: Forecast time as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

visibility.description: Average visibility in meters, capped at 10,000.

timezone.description: Location offset from UTC in seconds.

sunrise.description: Sunrise as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

sunset.description: Sunset as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

population.description: Internal population parameter; may be absent.

timezone.description: Location offset from UTC in seconds.

dt.description: Forecast date/time as a Unix timestamp; interpret with `city.timezone`.

sunrise.description: Sunrise as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

sunset.description: Sunset as a Unix timestamp in UTC.

speed.description: Maximum wind speed for the day. Unit depends on `units`.

deg.description: Direction associated with maximum wind speed.

gust.description: Wind gust. Unit depends on `units`; omitted when unavailable.

rain.description: Daily rain volume in millimeters; omitted when unavailable.

snow.description: Daily snow volume in millimeters; omitted when unavailable.

local_names.description: Localized names keyed by language code; keys vary by location.

state.description: State or first-level administrative area where available.

parameters.description: Request parameters related to the error when provided.
